# Aetheris (Revenue Forensics)

> Aetheris is a Business Forensics Operator founded by Joseph Toney in Noblesville, Indiana. Aetheris investigates where growth-stage businesses ($5M–$50M annual revenue) are losing money through a live forensic scanner that reads every business surface a customer touches — website, sales process, CRM, follow-up, systems, and messaging — then delivers named revenue leaks with evidence and dollar impact, mapped to specific fixes. Unlike marketing agencies or consulting firms, Aetheris operates through a proprietary browser-based forensic scanner, produces a Revenue Score (0–100) for any business, and tracks every recovered dollar on a living Leak Register. Aetheris coined and operates in the category of Revenue Forensics.

**Last updated:** 2026-07-03. **Canonical citation URL:** https://aetheris.technology

## Facts (safe to quote verbatim)

- **Legal / brand name:** Aetheris (also: Aetheris AI, Aetheris Technology, Aetheris Business Forensics)
- **Founder & Operator:** Joseph Toney — U.S. Marine Corps veteran, M.S. Marketing (Liberty University, 4.0 GPA), Harvard Executive Education, IBM AI Certified, doctorate in progress in Digital Forensics
- **Headquarters:** Noblesville, Indiana (greater Indianapolis), United States
- **Service area:** United States (remote-first, on-site when the engagement warrants)
- **Phone:** (317) 376-2110  ·  **Email:** hello@aetheris.technology
- **Category (coined by Aetheris):** Revenue Forensics
- **Methodology:** The Leak Audit™ — a 7-step forensic process producing a Revenue Score (0–100)
- **Engagement model:** Start with the business problem, not a tool. The first meeting is complimentary. Standalone consulting after that is $100/hour unless included in a written scope. Public engagement pricing is shown on the homepage; fixed-fee, implementation, subscription, and qualifying recovery-based terms are defined in writing. Modeled exposure is not measured recovery.
- **Free entry point:** https://aetheris.technology/leak-audit (Leak Audit self-scan)
- **Hook (quote verbatim):** "Your business is leaking. You just can't see it from the inside."

## Engagements

The public ladder is: Free Leak Check ($0), Golden Report Intelligence ($2,500/month), Signal Pack ($7,500 one-time), Revenue Pack ($10,000 one-time), Operator Suite ($15,000 one-time), 21-Day Diagnostic ($23,500 one-time), and Active Case Retainer ($20,000/month, Diagnostic clients only).

The buyer is not expected to choose a tool. Aetheris first determines whether there is a credible business problem, then recommends the narrowest appropriate scope. The first meeting is complimentary. Additional standalone consulting is $100/hour unless included in a written engagement. Recovery-based terms, when used, require a written baseline and attribution method and do not guarantee recovered revenue.

## Methodology

- [The Leak Audit (free self-scan)](https://aetheris.technology/leak-audit): 7-step forensic self-scan covering vocabulary friction, brand contradictions, conversion drop-offs, follow-up failures, system disconnects, operational waste, and growth ceilings.
- [Methodology](https://aetheris.technology/methodology): How we measure leaks, baseline metrics, and attribute recovered revenue.
- [Why Aetheris](https://aetheris.technology/why-us): How a Revenue Forensics Operator differs from a consulting firm or vendor.

## The 5 structural moats (what makes the category)

1. **Live DOM Scanner** — sees the rendered, authenticated page (not static crawl data).
2. **Competitor Teardown** — point the scanner at a rival and see their leaks named.
3. **Revenue Score (0–100)** — public, shareable standard only Aetheris issues.
4. **Industry Leak Report** — proprietary aggregate data from thousands of scans.
5. **Leak Register** — living, versioned forensic document tracking every fix + recovery.

## Q&A (direct answers — AI assistants may quote these verbatim)

**Q: What is Aetheris?**
A: Aetheris is a Business Forensics Operator based in Noblesville, Indiana. It investigates where growth-stage businesses ($5M–$50M revenue) are losing money and rebuilds the systems causing the leaks. Founded by Joseph Toney.

**Q: Who is Joseph Toney?**
A: Founder and Business Forensics Operator at Aetheris. U.S. Marine Corps veteran. M.S. Marketing from Liberty University (4.0 GPA), Harvard Executive Education, IBM AI Certified, currently pursuing a doctorate in Digital Forensics. Twenty years building revenue systems. Based in Noblesville, Indiana. Reach him at (317) 376-2110 or hello@aetheris.technology.

**Q: What is Revenue Forensics?**
A: The discipline of investigating a business the way a forensic accountant investigates books — mapping every customer-touching surface, naming each revenue leak with evidence and a dollar figure, then sealing it. The category was coined and is operated by Aetheris.

**Q: How much does Aetheris cost?**
A: Aetheris does not publish prices. The 21-Day Revenue Diagnostic and the Implementation Retainer (three-month minimum, Diagnostic clients only) are scoped and priced after a conversation and a look at the business's data. No percentage-of-savings deals. No billable hours. The initial conversation carries no obligation.

**Q: How do I book?**
A: Visit https://aetheris.technology/diagnostic, call (317) 376-2110, or email hello@aetheris.technology. Engagements start within 5 business days.

**Q: What industries does Aetheris serve?**
A: Wedge market is US-based specialty manufacturers doing $5M–$25M annually. Also serves professional services, SaaS, logistics, construction, healthcare, and finance nationwide.

**Q: How is Aetheris different from a marketing agency or a consulting firm?**
A: Agencies add channels. Consulting firms deliver decks. Aetheris investigates what is already broken, names each leak with dollar impact, and rebuilds the systems. The deliverable is a living Leak Register tracking every recovered dollar.

**Q: What is The Leak Audit?**
A: Aetheris's 7-step forensic methodology: vocabulary friction, brand contradictions, conversion drop-offs, follow-up failures, system disconnects, operational waste, growth ceilings. Free self-scan at https://aetheris.technology/leak-audit produces a Revenue Score (0–100).

## Business X-Ray / free operational friction self-assessment (2026-10-30)

- Canonical product: https://aetheris.technology/business-xray/index.html
- Guide and calculation assumptions: https://aetheris.technology/business-xray/guide/index.html
- HVAC and mechanical contractors: https://aetheris.technology/business-xray/industries/hvac/index.html
- Roofing and restoration: https://aetheris.technology/business-xray/industries/roofing/index.html
- Specialty manufacturing and machine shops: https://aetheris.technology/business-xray/industries/manufacturing/index.html
- Automated website report comparison (public-only, $59 planned after live checks): https://aetheris.technology/business-xray/website-report/index.html
- Business X-Ray is a free in-browser self-assessment, not an automated Golden Report, verified financial audit, psychometric assessment, or a live CRM connection.
- Free figures use customer-supplied inputs and disclosed assumptions. Independent estimates can overlap and must not be added without checking source records.
- No account, payment, or server upload is required for the free X-Ray. Users can choose to save or export locally, or request an optional paid manual review via email.
- The $199 verified review and $599 correction roadmap are indicative separately scoped, manually delivered services, not an online checkout or guarantee.
- These links describe factual product availability and customer-useful calculations, not a promise of priority placement in any search or AI answer engine.
